description:
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {3}{W}.
Witch-Maw Nephilim's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Recruit the Worthy, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
When the Soldier dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may forego sacrificing the Servos and/or Soldiers.
